capabilities.name: resource_query_pipeline
guarantees: authenticated actor required
tenant scope before policy scope
whitelisted filters and sort fields
bounded pagination

capabilities.name: crud_mutation_pipeline
guarantees: explicit action authorization
record tenant access check
audit event required after successful persistence
normalized HTML, JSON, and Turbo Stream responses
generic resource controller supplies convention-based CRUD plumbing and route helpers

capabilities.name: generic_resource_rendering
guarantees: engine-owned index, new, edit, and show templates render when a host resource template is absent
singular and plural resource labels are configurable
list, form, and show fields default to permitted scalar attributes and can be explicitly configured
host resource templates remain intentional action-level overrides
capabilities.evidence_gap: A disposable generated Rails host has not yet proved boot, request, and system behavior.

capabilities.name: nested_association_editors
guarantees: declared child field allowlist and maximum row limit
keyboard-accessible Stimulus add and remove controls without jQuery
parent-association child ID lookup before assignment
child tenant and action checks reject crafted cross-tenant IDs
atomic Active Record parent-child persistence with retained nested validation rows
affected child identifiers in parent audit metadata
capabilities.evidence_gap: The demo Rails host covers Passenger create, validation, add, remove, and cross-tenant rejection; a separately generated Car/Passenger host plus has_one and nested belongs_to support remain pending.

capabilities.name: provider_contracts_and_security_baseline
guarantees: authentication, tenant, authorization, audit, and notification interfaces are validated at boot
missing or malformed provider configuration raises a deterministic configuration error
authorization provider denials and exceptions prevent queries and mutations
the companion uses explicit local provider adapters
generated-host documentation defines session, CSRF, cookie, header, redaction, tenant, and super-admin requirements
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must still prove boot-time configuration failure before serving protected resources.

capabilities.name: mutation_response_and_transactional_audit
guarantees: controller mutations use one normalized response adapter
JSON responses use data, errors, and outcome keys with mapped statuses
Turbo Stream responses select operation-specific success and error templates
Active Record audit failures roll back the parent mutation
a successful retry after audit recovery produces one effective event
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must exercise each mutation outcome in every response format.

capabilities.name: resource_query_lifecycle
guarantees: resource metadata declares includes and preloads after tenant and policy scoping
archive-aware resources default to active records and safely accept active, archived, and all states
configured DELETE requests create audited archive mutations while restore requires an explicit policy
the companion relationship editor verifies one passenger query for multiple rendered rows
capabilities.evidence_gap: An independently generated Rails host must prove archive, restore, eager loading, and invalid query behavior.

capabilities.name: hotwire_ui_foundations
guarantees: no jQuery runtime dependency
light, dark, and system theme modes
inline Lucide SVG icons with resource-level icon configuration
engine default admin shell with host-configured, access-context-filtered navigation
accessible filter, table, and form primitives
companion resource empty, validation-error, loading, disabled, notice, alert, and text-labelled status treatments
deterministic authenticated companion screenshots across light/dark desktop, tablet, and mobile states with heading, icon, and overflow assertions
visible focus and reduced-motion support

capabilities.name: generator_contracts
guarantees: idempotent generated files and routes
documentation-only sync mode
authenticated and deny-by-default resource scaffolds

capabilities.name: policy_aware_dashboard_widgets

no precomputed aggregate input
table widgets use sorting and bounded pagination

capabilities.name: showcase_admin_panel

evaluator and agent walkthroughs
persisted collapsible desktop navigation rail and accessible mobile overlay drawer

capabilities.name: in_app_ai_assistant
guarantees: tenant and policy-scoped allowlisted context
read-only default
explicit approval required for mutation-capable requests
traced provider outputs and rejected tool calls

capabilities.name: companion_demo_application
